cases.case_label: L1 insertion in intron 6 of SLCO1B3
cases.mechanism_detail: An SLCO1B3 intron 6 LINE-1 insertion was detected by nanopore amplicon sequencing in the first genetically confirmed Rotor syndrome patient in Hong Kong; only the title is available.
cases.quote: Detection of SLCO1B3 intron 6 LINE-1 insertion by Nanopore Flongle Amplicon Sequencing in the first genetically confirmed Rotor syndrome patient in Hong Kong.
